reason_for_version: The v1 central route passed a centreline and non-overlap check but retained only 0.075 m nominal rectangular-body clearance, reproducing the preflight's edge-hugging failure mechanism. No navigation evidence was collected with v1 routes.
purpose: Choose one deterministic Q0 and Q1 route per registered task without using final-audit labels or navigation outcomes.

nominal_route_prior.rationale: A fixed conservative route-design prior, declared before execution and shared by both arms; it is not estimated from the final audit.

candidate_generation: All deterministic lane-graph polylines plus every geometry-valid path through the centre of a vertical traversable rectangle. Candidate generation uses only the registered driveable-region union.
selection_rule: First require at least 0.10 m static clearance for the 0.80 m by 0.55 m rectangular body along line segments and in-place corner rotations. Then convert each remaining geometry-only candidate into the runtime bounded-unicycle seed; fail closed unless the runtime swept rectangular-footprint rollout is valid and ends within 0.35 m of the task goal. Among eligible candidates minimize the unchanged metric_expected_belief total cost; use candidate name only as an exact-cost tie break.

route_gate.additional_gate: The selector also requires the runtime swept rectangular-footprint rollout to pass; neither centreline clearance nor static sampled body clearance replaces the continuous rollout gate.

final_audit_firewall: The final detector/localization audit decides release only. Its labels, residuals and outcomes do not enter candidate generation, route scoring or route selection.
execution_design: After selection, route JSON and source JSON are hash-bound. Five matched stochastic seeds replay each selected arm route. No global optimizer runs during a navigation replicate.
